pilot_design: Three original PDF pages, nine visually transcribed cells; no OCR output used to establish gold. Language order alternated by page. Single timing per arm, under shared system load; timing precision and held-out accuracy unmeasured.
gold_normalization: Remove punctuation and whitespace; uppercase. Do not conflate I/l/1 or repair digits.
conclusion: English-only Pareto-improves the sampled field reads and reduces observed OCR runtime. No Bengali printed GP/category sample was found in the visually inspected ward pages. These results are not an accuracy estimate for uninspected documents.
